name: zc_skin_locomotion

tests.name: Celestial Light is on, so there is a costume to hold against the Dog
run: the skin wears the Dog's pose field for field
body bounce: the Dog's bob reaches the skin, same frame

detail.note: a swing near zero is not a failure here -- stillness damps the bob to nothing by design

tests.name: stop: the skin wears the Dog's pose field for field
ground contact: standing still, the Dog is not airborne

detail.note: lift_uu is the act/flight overlay, recorded not gated

tests.name: turns: the Dog turns, and the skin holds the Dog's pose throughout

detail.note: body_yaw_deg is a relative lean and stays near zero; the heading is the actor's yaw

tests.name: fall: the skin is told it is falling, with the Dog's own pose

detail.note: dropped from 9 m rather than walked off a ledge, so the state is certain

tests.name: landing: the skin comes back to the ground with the Dog
